question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: NEOPHYTE
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Beginner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Neophyte"** refers to someone who is new to a subject, skill, or activity. It typically denotes a beginner or a novice. (नवागंतुक)
 
 
• **Example:** As a neophyte in gardening, she eagerly sought advice from experienced gardeners.
 
 
• **"Beginner"** means a person who is just starting to learn or engage in something. (शुरुआती)
 
 
• **Example:** The beginner struggled to understand the complex rules of chess but showed great enthusiasm.
 
 
• Hence, "Neophyte" is synonymous with "Beginner."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Veteran** (अनुभवी): A person who has long experience in a particular field.
 
 
• **Example:** The veteran soldier shared stories of his bravery during the war.
 
 
 
• **Master** (माहिर): Someone who has exceptional skill or knowledge in a particular area.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a master of culinary arts and runs a renowned restaurant.
 
 
 
• **Expert** (विशेषज्ञ): A person who is very knowledgeable or skillful in a specific field.
 
 
• **Example:** The expert provided valuable insights into the workings of the financial markets.
 
 

48:Tb39,

The correct answer is: Option 3</b&g
